ctx.x: Theo. Bonner on saxophone, W.B. Woodman, trombone, and Sonny Clay, piano and drums, saxophones and various instruments. He played a lot of different things, huh?

Well, I never know him to play saxophone. He played, I think, marimba and piano and...and, let's see, what else Sonny played? I think he played drum...I think he played drums in my brother's orchestra. I think he was a drummer when he first come here from Tucson.
